olevel_requirement: Five (5) SSC credit passes in English Language, Mathematics and three (3) other relevant Arts/Sciences/Social Sciences subjects.
direct_entry: (i) Two (2) 'A' Level passes in relevant subject plus the UTME requirements. (ii) NCE merit in relevant subjects.

institution_waivers.note: UNIZIK requires one (1) of the 'A' Level or NCE subject to be combined with Library Science.
BAYERO accept NCE merit provided such candidates have two (2) years working experience.
MAIDUGURI accepts NCE/ND/HND in related studies.
